decisions.reason: The historic mill tour builds on the firm's investments in event and hospitality facilities and publicly showcases its heritage, and any pandemic-related weakness in 2020-2021 can be attributed to temporary causes, so management stays committed.
The sweet pastry belongs to the core confectionery range, and management has already justified keeping it once, so it persists despite unclear results.
The crusty farmhouse bread fits the traditional bread offer at low incremental cost, and with no evidence of failure management keeps it rather than admit a misstep.
The award-winning poppy seed stollen is publicly presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so commitment to it is very strong.
The gold-awarded premium stollen supports the firm's festive quality image and is publicly promoted, so management keeps it.
